Crop: Potato | Stage: Land Preparation | Days: -15 to 0
Season: Kharif/Rabi

Key tasks:
- Deep plough and prepare fine tilth
- Apply basal FYM and level field
- Soil testing and nutrient balancing

Fertilizer: Basal dose incorporated into soil (FYM + NPK)
Irrigation: Pre-sowing irrigation to ensure adequate moisture
Watch for: Soil-borne pathogens, weed seeds
Why it matters: Good land preparation ensures proper root penetration and uniform germination.

Critical: YES - crucial for overall Potato success.

Crop: Potato | Stage: Germination & Early Growth | Days: 0-20
Season: Kharif/Rabi

Key tasks:
- Sow seeds at appropriate depth and spacing
- Check for uniform emergence and gap-fill if necessary
- First manual weeding

Fertilizer: No additional fertilizer; rely on basal dose
Irrigation: Light irrigation if soil surface dries out to prevent crusting
Watch for: Damping-off disease, cutworms, poor emergence
Why it matters: A uniform plant stand is critical as gaps directly reduce potential yield.

Critical: YES - crucial for overall Potato success.

Crop: Potato | Stage: Vegetative Growth | Days: 21-50
Season: Kharif/Rabi

Key tasks:
- Top-dress fertilizer (Nitrogen split)
- Second weeding or herbicide application
- Scout for foliar pests and diseases weekly

Fertilizer: Top-dress with Urea/Nitrogen
Irrigation: Regular irrigation cycle based on crop water requirements
Watch for: Leaf-eating caterpillars, aphids, early signs of leaf blight
Why it matters: Healthy canopy development drives photosynthesis needed for later yield.

Critical: YES - crucial for overall Potato success.

Crop: Potato | Stage: Flowering / Reproductive Phase | Days: 51-80
Season: Kharif/Rabi

Key tasks:
- Avoid chemical sprays during peak flowering to protect pollinators
- Maintain consistent soil moisture
- Apply micronutrient spray if required

Fertilizer: Avoid heavy Nitrogen; focus on Potassium if deficient
Irrigation: Critical stage: ensure no moisture stress to prevent flower/fruit drop
Watch for: Flower drop, pod borers, sucking pests
Why it matters: Moisture or pest stress during flowering directly reduces the number of fruits/grains formed.

Critical: YES - crucial for overall Potato success.

Crop: Potato | Stage: Fruit / Grain Development | Days: 81-110
Season: Kharif/Rabi

Key tasks:
- Monitor for pod/fruit borers
- Ensure proper drainage if heavy rains occur
- Final rounds of irrigation before maturity

Fertilizer: Foliar application if nutrient deficiency is visible
Irrigation: Maintain moisture but avoid waterlogging
Watch for: Fruit rot, pod borers, birds/rodents
Why it matters: Proper grain/fruit filling requires sustained water and nutrient transport.

Critical: YES - crucial for overall Potato success.

Crop: Potato | Stage: Harvesting | Days: 111-130
Season: Kharif/Rabi

Key tasks:
- Stop irrigation 10-15 days before harvest
- Harvest at proper maturity index (color/moisture)
- Dry produce to safe moisture levels before storage

Fertilizer: None
Irrigation: Stop irrigation to allow drying and maturation
Watch for: Shattering losses, unseasonal rain damage
Why it matters: Timely harvest prevents post-maturity field losses and ensures good market quality.

Critical: YES - crucial for overall Potato success.
